parsed.rationale: This is sinus rhythm with narrow QRS complexes and no ST elevation meeting STEMI thresholds in any lead. V2–V3 show only minimal J-point elevation with prominent upright T waves, which looks like a normal or early-repolarization variant. There are no reciprocal ST depressions or pathologic Q waves, so it does not support the team's acute STEMI impression.
